raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-STP-YouthEmployment",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Financial management deficiencies such as delays in transaction recording, reporting, or internal audits may weaken financial controls and implementation.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Designate an experienced project accountant, customize the computerized accounting software, and incorporate clear criteria in the Project Operations Manual.",
      "evidence": "FM risks identified include: (i) delays in recording financial transactions and generating financial reports; (ii) internal audit reviews not conducted"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Marginalized groups in remote regions or low-income households risk exclusion or elite capture in the selection of sub-grant and training beneficiaries.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Target beneficiaries using the Unique Social Registry (USR), apply strict female participation quotas, and establish transparent selection criteria in the POM.",
      "evidence": "risks of exclusion, which may arise if project benefits are not equitably distributed... as well as risks of elite capture in the selection of beneficiaries"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Female beneficiaries participating in technical training or internship placements face risks of sexual exploitation, abuse, and sexual harassment.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire a Social Specialist with GBV/SEA/SH expertise, implement safe training guidelines, and enforce SEA/SH prevention mechanisms in provider contracts.",
      "evidence": "community health and safety risks, including risks of sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) and sexual harassment (SH), particularly for young women"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Minor civil works and small business activities in agriculture, fisheries, or tourism may generate waste or cause localized pressure on sensitive island ecosystems.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint an Environmental Specialist, conduct environmental screening for sub-grants, and enforce EDGE design standards and construction waste management.",
      "evidence": "small business grants could support micro-enterprises in agriculture, fisheries, or tourism that may indirectly place pressure on sensitive ecosystems or cause localized pollution"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Delays or weak collaboration between MLSSS and AFAP in providing technical inputs and terms of reference could stall key procurement processes.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish standard operational workflows in the POM and maintain close operational oversight through a unified PIU and Ministerial Coordination Committee.",
      "evidence": "A key factor for good procurement performance will be the ability of AFAP and the MLSSS to work in close collaboration"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Failure to recruit key PIU and AFAP specialists within contractual deadlines after effectiveness may cause operational and compliance delays.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Initiate recruitment and terms of reference preparation early, prioritizing the hiring of environmental, social, TVET, and IT specialists.",
      "evidence": "The Recipient shall cause AFAP to hire or appoint, not later than forty-five (45) days after Effectiveness: (i) one Environmental Specialist..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Recurrent climate events such as severe storms, flash flooding, and rising sea levels may disrupt project service delivery and cause operational delays.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate-resilient designs for new infrastructure, install back-up generators and cloud systems for digital tools, and phase training delivery.",
      "evidence": "Key climate and disaster risks that may affect the project include floods, droughts, and rising sea levels... cause disruptions in service delivery"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Extreme geographic isolation and insularity of Príncipe island increase logistics complexity and costs for constructing the new technical training center.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Refine cost assumptions through detailed architectural and engineering studies, utilize local materials, and manage contingencies through the procurement plan.",
      "evidence": "Príncipe—home to just about 10,000 people—is more than 170 km away and experiences compounded isolation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Target public TVET centers possess outdated equipment, staffing gaps, and weak employer links, threatening the market relevance of technical training.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Form Workforce Development Committees with private employers, modernize equipment, and tie institutional co-financing to training performance in priority skills.",
      "evidence": "capacity remains constrained by outdated equipment, limited infrastructure, insufficient operating budgets, staffing gaps, and weak employer participation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Failure or delay in contracting an eligible payment agent satisfies a disbursement condition that would block stipend, grant, and scholarship payouts.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize the early competitive procurement of a qualified electronic Payment Service Provider (PSP) following established social protection models.",
      "evidence": "For Disbursement category 2 'Sub-Grants': The Recipient has (i) hired a payment agent in accordance with Section I.F of Schedule 2"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "The new LMIS and Employability Portal risk low operational uptake or abandonment, repeating failures of earlier tools like the ILO Employment Observatory.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct early user mapping, engage specialized IT consultancies, mandate portal usage for program participants, and incentivize private employer listings.",
      "evidence": "Employment Observatory was previously developed with support from the International Labour Organization (ILO) but never fully operationalized"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "High dependence on ODA and volatile domestic revenues expose the government to macroeconomic shocks that could jeopardize institutional sustainability.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Embed job programs within line ministry operations, leverage private sector demand in growth sectors, and foster co-financing with international partners.",
      "evidence": "Persistently low domestic revenue mobilization has kept STP heavily dependent on Official Development Assistance (ODA)... leaving fiscal revenues highly volatile."
    }
  ]
}
